name: Perseverance Landing Hardware

locations.label: Octavia E. Butler Landing Debris Field, Jezero Crater

summary: The parachute and backshell that protected the Perseverance rover during atmospheric entry.
hook: My parachute and backshell brought Perseverance to Jezero Crater and were later photographed by Ingenuity.
how_it_worked: A supersonic nylon parachute and protective aeroshell slowed the entry vehicle from orbital velocities.
science: Provided valuable engineering data on high-speed entry parachute dynamics in the thin Martian atmosphere.

facts.text: The 70-foot supersonic parachute carried a coded binary pattern spelling Dare Mighty Things in its canopy.
The debris field was imaged from an aerial vantage point by the Ingenuity helicopter during Flight 26.

image.alt: Debris field of the Perseverance backshell and parachute photographed from the air by Ingenuity
